animatedplayer.configuration.title: Animated Player
animatedplayer.configuration.preview.hin: Hover an option to see what it does
animatedplayer.configuration.Enabled.too: Off: players are drawn exactly as in vanilla.
animatedplayer.configuration.ApplyTo.too: Which players are animated: everyone, only you, or only the other players.
animatedplayer.configuration.AnimationDi: Other players farther than this are drawn as in vanilla, for performance.
animatedplayer.configuration.AnimationIn: Strength of the body animations. 100%: as designed; 0%: straight, vanilla-like body.
animatedplayer.configuration.IdleAnimati: Relaxed stance and breathing when standing still. Off: vanilla straight stance when not moving; every other animation stays.
animatedplayer.configuration.SwordAnimat: Dedicated attack animation when holding a sword. Off: the regular punch swing.
animatedplayer.configuration.SupermanFly: Superman pose when flying in creative mode (the original mod's animation). Off: the hovering pose.
animatedplayer.configuration.AnimateFace: Animate eyes, eyebrows and mouth, for skins that draw them in the hidden head area.
animatedplayer.configuration.EyeMovement: Eyes follow where the player looks.
animatedplayer.configuration.EyebrowExpr: Eyebrows rise when fighting, sneaking or aiming.
animatedplayer.configuration.HungerEyebr: Eyebrows frown as the hunger bar empties.
animatedplayer.configuration.BreathlessM: Mouth opens to catch breath after sprinting or jumping.
animatedplayer.configuration.RoundedLimb: Rounded forearms, lower legs and chest, as in the original mod: smooth elbows and knees. Off: plain Minecraft cubes.
animatedplayer.configuration.BetterHat.t: Render the hat layer as small cubes that follow the head shape.
animatedplayer.configuration.SkinLayers3: Render the second skin layer (jacket, sleeves, pants) in 3D, like the hat. Turn off with mods such as 3D Skin Layers.
